values.meaning: Swinging Kama empowered basic attack bonus magic damage
values.quote: {{pplevel|35 to 53 for 7; then + 9*x for 6; then + 15*x|formula=+3 per level until lvl 7; then +9 until lvl 13, then +15|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}}

mechanics.claim: When Akali damages an enemy champion with an ability, she creates a ring around them for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent damaging abilities against champions.
mechanics.quote: When '''Akali''' damages an enemy {{tip|champion}} with an {{tip|ability}}, she creates a ring around them for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent damaging abilities against champions.

mechanics.claim: Only one ring may be active at a time.
mechanics.quote: Only one ring may be active at a time.

mechanics.claim: When Akali exits the ring, she becomes empowered with Swinging Kama for 4 seconds, during which she cannot create another ring.
mechanics.quote: becomes empowered with ''Swinging Kama'' for 4 seconds, during which she cannot create another ring.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack is uncancellable and gains doubled range.
mechanics.quote: '''Akali's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|{{tt|'''doubled''' range|Not necessarily increased by 125, check notes}}}}

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack can be dodged and blocked, and will be mitigated by blinds.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack can be {{tip|dodge|dodged}} and {{tip|block|blocked}}, and will be mitigated by {{tip|blind|blinds}}.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed nor apply its effects against structures and wards.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed nor apply its effects against {{tip|structures}} and {{tip|wards}}.

mechanics.claim: This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's stats at the time of its application.
mechanics.quote: This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's stats at the time of its application.
